summary: RenewCrewLease refusals as the backend model returns them, each old code's mapping, and what the Crew does.

provisional.why: awsJson1_0 per the backend model. That the server routes on X-Amz-Target at POST / is pending the backend team, contract section 13 item 18.
The statuses are the model's httpError values. Whether the service honors them on awsJson1_0 is pending, contract section 13 item 5.
The bearer authentication layer answers before the operation. Its status and body are not in the model, contract section 13 item 5.

provisional.field: typed states without a model reason
provisional.why: ENDPOINT_MISMATCH, HOSTING_NOT_ALLOWED, CREW_IDENTITY_DISABLED and VERSION_UNSUPPORTED have no reason in the model. Pending the backend team, contract section 13 item 24.
An absolute time in the model. The Crew's wait rule is pending the backend team, contract section 13 item 23.

planPosition: The Crew reads the exception from __type, dropping any namespace before # and anything after :.
The takeover wait: takeoverAfter minus the HTTP Date header of the same response, clamped to 1 to 120 seconds. 120 seconds when the Date header is missing or unreadable.

refusals.when: The organization does not allow remote access. No token.
refusals.callerDoes: Stop connecting. Show the reason in Settings. Try again on the next sign-in or setting change, and at most every 15 minutes.

example.message: The organization does not allow remote access.

refusals.modelStatus: In the model, with takeoverAfter, the earliest time this instance can take over.
refusals.when: A team Crew's lease is held by a different instance and is still live.
refusals.callerDoes: Don't connect. Wait takeoverAfter minus the response's Date header, clamped to 1 to 120 seconds, then renew. Never compare takeoverAfter with the device's clock. The host shows identity in use.

refusals.modelStatus: No reason in the model. It can arrive only as a ValidationException, with a reason the Crew cannot tie to this case.
refusals.when: relay.endpointId is not the one the backend derives for this caller and instance.
refusals.callerDoes: On a ValidationException to a renewal that carried relay.endpointId, drop the stored endpointId and renew once without it. A second ValidationException stops, as below.

refusals.modelStatus: No reason in the model. Today it shows as an AccessDeniedException with no Crew reason, or as a sign-in failure for a credential type the operation doesn't accept.
refusals.when: This sign-in cannot host a Crew.
refusals.callerDoes: No handling of its own while the model has no reason for it. The Crew can't tell it apart from the refusal it arrives as, so it follows that row: the AccessDeniedException row, or the sign-in failure row.

refusals.modelStatus: No reason in the model. Today it may show as an AccessDeniedException with reason CrewAccessNotGranted, which the model says covers a Crew identity that is not active, or as a ResourceNotFoundException.
refusals.when: The team Crew's identity is disabled or deleted, or its key was rotated.
refusals.callerDoes: No handling of its own while the model has no reason for it. As an AccessDeniedException with reason CrewAccessNotGranted, the Crew follows the AccessDeniedException row. As a ResourceNotFoundException, it follows that row. The host connection closes when its token expires.

refusals.modelStatus: No reason in the model. It can arrive only as a ValidationException.
refusals.when: protocolVersion is below the backend's minimum.
refusals.callerDoes: Covered by the ValidationException row. The relay's own hello refusal, version_unsupported with close 4401, still says an upgrade is needed.

refusals.modelStatus: In the model, with or without a reason.
refusals.when: Any other access refusal, including reason CrewAccessNotGranted.
refusals.callerDoes: Stop. Show that this sign-in can't host the Crew now. Try again on the next sign-in or setting change, and at most every 15 minutes.

refusals.modelStatus: In the model. What it means on this operation is pending.
refusals.when: The backend found no Crew for this caller, for example a deleted team Crew identity.

refusals.modelStatus: In the model. reason is one of the model's ValidationExceptionReason values.
refusals.callerDoes: Log the message and reason. Apply the ENDPOINT_MISMATCH row once if it fits, otherwise stop and show that the Crew needs an update.

refusals.modelStatus: In the model. It carries no wait time, so retryAfterSeconds is gone.
refusals.when: Too many calls for this caller.

example.message: Too many calls for this caller.

refusals.callerDoes: Retry with the renewal retry steps and full jitter, section 11.2.
Retry with the renewal retry steps and full jitter, section 11.2.

refusals.modelStatus: Not in the model. The bearer authentication layer refuses the credential before the operation runs. Its status and body are open. 401 is expected but not confirmed.
refusals.when: The caller's own credential was refused.
refusals.callerDoes: Refresh the sign-in or credential. A personal Crew asks the owner to sign in again.
